Google, Apple and Microsoft block their sign-in buttons inside apps, so they cannot finish here. In this window, sign in to Puter with your Puter username (or email) and password. If your Puter account only has Google sign-in: open puter.com in Chrome, sign in with Google, then set a password under Settings, Account. The app server models (NVIDIA, OpenRouter and others) work without Puter.
